$comment: External course directory — official and high-quality learning resources that fill gaps or complement LMVersity tracks. Every entry links to the provider's official page; no affiliate relationships exist; entries are listed for learner benefit, not partnership. costModel: free | free-audit | freemium | subscription | paid | mixed.

openai-academy.title: OpenAI Academy
openai-academy.note: OpenAI's own learning hub — product tutorials plus developer sessions.

openai-cookbook.title: OpenAI Cookbook
openai-cookbook.note: Runnable examples for the OpenAI API — code-first reference.

anthropic-courses.title: Anthropic courses
anthropic-courses.note: Anthropic's course material on GitHub — prompt engineering through tool use and evaluation.

anthropic-cookbook.title: Anthropic Cookbook
anthropic-cookbook.note: Copyable code patterns for the Claude API.

google-skills.title: Google Skills
google-skills.note: Google's consolidated learning platform (Cloud Skills Boost lineage). Bot-check on automated probes — open in a browser.

google-ai-studio.title: Google AI Studio
google-ai-studio.note: Free environment for trying Gemini models and prompt prototyping.

microsoft-learn.title: Microsoft Learn
microsoft-learn.note: Free modules and learning paths across Azure AI, Copilot extensibility, and agents.

aws-skill-builder.title: AWS Skill Builder
aws-skill-builder.note: AWS's learning platform — free courses plus paid exam-prep subscriptions.

nvidia-dli.title: NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute
nvidia-dli.note: Hands-on GPU labs; many self-paced courses free, workshops paid.

huggingface-learn.title: Hugging Face courses
huggingface-learn.note: Free NLP, agents, and smol-course material tied to the HF ecosystem.

deeplearningai.title: DeepLearning.AI courses
deeplearningai.note: Andrew Ng's catalog — short courses on current topics plus full specializations.

fastai.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
fastai.note: Top-down, code-first deep learning — the classic free practical course.

fsdl.title: Full Stack Deep Learning
fsdl.note: Production ML systems end to end — lectures and materials openly published.

kaggle-learn.title: Kaggle Learn
kaggle-learn.note: Short practical courses plus competitions for applied practice.

databricks-academy.title: Databricks Academy
databricks-academy.note: Official Databricks training incl. genAI application courses.

mongodb-university.title: MongoDB University
mongodb-university.note: Free official courses incl. vector-search material relevant to RAG.

pinecone-learn.title: Pinecone Learning Center
pinecone-learn.note: Vector-database and RAG tutorials from the Pinecone team.

langchain-academy.title: LangChain Academy
langchain-academy.note: Official LangChain/LangGraph courses — agent building on their stack.

langfuse-academy.title: Langfuse Academy
langfuse-academy.note: Official LLM observability/evaluation course from Langfuse.

llamaindex-docs.title: LlamaIndex docs and examples
llamaindex-docs.note: No separate academy domain — the docs' examples serve as the learning path.

nptel.title: NPTEL open courses
nptel.note: Indian university courses openly published — AI/ML syllabi verifiable per course; certificates via paid proctored exam.

swayam.title: SWAYAM open learning
swayam.note: India's MOOC platform — university courses free to study, optional paid certificates.

ai4bharat.title: AI4Bharat open resources
ai4bharat.note: Open Indic language models, datasets, and tools — resources rather than a course.

bhashini.title: Bhashini ecosystem
bhashini.note: National translation mission — language APIs and datasets via official channels.
